_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The base rate is 0% of 49 windows moved ±2+ points — this coil holds until either institutional re-entry (ETF flows >30, DXY <99) or structural breakdown (BTC <$61K with sustained exchange inflows) breaks the deadlock.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil regime and 0/15 direction accuracy; narrative implies a directional recovery lean, creating a split on forward direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks below $61,000 with exchange_netflow sustaining 100 and funding flipping negative — signals Capitulation leg beginning
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows spike above 30 with DXY breaking below 99 and BTC funding rising above 0.015% — signals Disbelief/Hope transition with institutional re-entry
